_schema.description: Blog posts listed on /blog.html, newest first. Each post is a hand-written HTML file under /blog/ (copy an existing post as a template). Add the post file, then prepend an entry here.

fields.title: string, required. Post title as displayed
fields.url: string, required. Absolute path to the post, e.g. /blog/slug.html (English slug, no pinyin)
